description: AT Protocol: submit a signed PLC operation for the account's DID to the PLC directory.

main.description: Validates a PLC operation to ensure it does not break the account, then submits it to the PLC directory. Only for the caller's own DID.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The operation is malformed or names another DID's chain.

errors.name: PlcRejected
errors.description: The PLC directory refused the operation.
